mapper.select: SELECT USER_NUM, FILE_URL, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM T_PORTFOLIO WHERE USER_NUM = #{userNum}
SELECT USER_NUM, GROWTH_PROCESS, PERSONALITY_STRENGTHS_WEAKNESSES, PROBLEM_SOLVING_EXPERIENCE, POST_JOINING_ASPIRATION, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM T_COVER_LETTER WHERE USER_NUM = #{userNum}

SELECT r.RESUME_NUM, r.USER_NUM, r.HIGHEST_LEVEL, r.EDUCATION_CODE, ec.EDUCATION_NAME, r.MOTIVATION, r.DESIRED_LOCATION, r.DESIRED_WORK_TYPE, r.CREATED_AT, r.UPDATED_AT FROM T_RESUME r JOIN T_EDUCODE ec ON r.EDUCATION_CODE = ec.EDUCATION_CODE WHERE r.USER_NUM = #{userNum} ORDER BY r.UPDATED_AT DESC, r.RESUME_NUM DESC

SELECT r.RESUME_NUM, r.USER_NUM, r.HIGHEST_LEVEL, r.EDUCATION_CODE, ec.EDUCATION_NAME, r.MOTIVATION, r.DESIRED_LOCATION, r.DESIRED_WORK_TYPE, r.CREATED_AT, r.UPDATED_AT FROM T_RESUME r JOIN T_EDUCODE ec ON r.EDUCATION_CODE = ec.EDUCATION_CODE WHERE r.RESUME_NUM = #{number} AND r.USER_NUM = #{userNum}
SELECT EDU_NUM, RESUME_NUM, SCHOOL_NAME, ADMISSION_DATE, GRADUATION_DATE, MAJOR, EDUCATION_STATUS FROM T_EDUCATION WHERE RESUME_NUM = #{resumeNum} ORDER BY ADMISSION_DATE DESC, EDU_NUM DESC
SELECT CAREER_NUM, RESUME_NUM, COMPANY_NAME, JOIN_DATE, RESIGN_DATE, MAIN_DUTY FROM T_CAREER WHERE RESUME_NUM = #{resumeNum} ORDER BY JOIN_DATE DESC, CAREER_NUM DESC
SELECT CERT_NUM, RESUME_NUM, CERT_NAME, CERT_GRADE, ISSUE_DATE FROM T_CERTIFICATION WHERE RESUME_NUM = #{resumeNum} ORDER BY ISSUE_DATE DESC, CERT_NUM DESC

SELECT u.USER_NUM, u.JOB_CODE, j.JOB_NAME, u.OCCUPATION_CODE, o.OCCUPATION_NAME FROM T_USER u LEFT JOIN T_JOB j ON u.JOB_CODE = j.JOB_CODE LEFT JOIN T_OCCUPATION o ON u.OCCUPATION_CODE = o.OCCUPATION_CODE WHERE u.USER_NUM = #{userNum} AND u.USER_IS_DELETED = 0
